name: Wall Drawing, after LeWitt
promptTemplate: A conceptual wall drawing rendered in {{palette}} with {{drafting_order}} execution, drafted at density {{instruction_density}} at speed {{draw_speed}} with {{line_weight}}px pencil weight.

drafting_order.hint: Order in which rays, arcs, and grids draft

instruction_density.hint: Number of rays, arcs, and crosshatch lines

draw_speed.hint: Execution tempo of the drawing cycle

line_weight.hint: Graphite line width on the wall

gallery.blurb: A wall drawing executed live from its instructions, in the spirit of Sol LeWitt: lines from the centre, arcs from the corners and grids in four directions drawn by an invisible hand, layer by layer, then erased and begun again.
gallery.prompt: A wall drawing executed live from its instructions, in the spirit of Sol LeWitt: lines from the centre, arcs from the corners and grids in four directions drawn by an invisible hand, layer by layer, then erased and begun again. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
